android.desc: Most personal finance management apps ask for your bank details, email access, or permission to analyze and track your habits. FinPlan.ME is an offline expense tracker app that takes a different approach — your financial data stays entirely on your device, always. Whether you're logging daily expenses, building a monthly budget by spending category, or working toward a savings goal, FinPlan.ME works like a private notebook: simple, clear, and entirely yours. Track every expense Log spending in seconds and assign it to a category — groceries, transport, dining, subscriptions, or any custom category you define. Flexible and straightforward personal bookkeeping. Budget by spending category Set monthly limits per category and see exactly where you stand. No surprises at the end of the month. Set and track savings goals Define what you're saving toward and watch your progress — all calculated on-device, no internet connection needed. Scan and store receipts Digitize paper receipts with the built-in scanner. Everything is saved locally on your phone. Monthly spending insights A clean monthly overview of your financial health. No endless lists — just your numbers, clearly laid out. What makes FinPlan.ME different • Fully offline — works anywhere, including without any internet • No account required — nothing to sign up for • No cloud storage — expense data stays on your device • No background tracking or data collection of any kind • Custom spending categories — use the defaults or build your own • Full local backup and restore — safely move data when switching phones • Dark and light mode • Available in English, Bulgarian, Romanian and Greek Your data, your control FinPlan.ME requests only the permissions it actually needs — camera access for receipt scanning, nothing else. No location tracking, no monitoring of other apps. To delete all your data, simply uninstall the app or clear its storage. A personal finance tracker built for people who want simple, private, offline expense tracking — without connecting their financial life to a server.
